mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_order (product_order_id, buyer_id, seller_id, product_id, price, quantity, product_title, product_description, product_images, product_trade_location, product_category, state, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{productOrderId}, #{buyerId}, #{sellerId}, #{productId}, #{price}, #{quantity}, #{productTitle}, #{productDescription}, #{productImages}, #{productTradeLocation}, #{productCategory}, #{state}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE product_order SET state = 'CANCELLED', update_time = NOW() WHERE product_order_id = #{orderId} AND state = 'PENDING_PAYMENT'
